Good evening, agent. Your mission - should you choose to accept it - is to infiltrate Space Station 14, steal valuable items, and sabotage their operations. You will be deployed to the station in their latest batch of research personnel. Our contacts have prepared a disguise as one of the members of the crew for you to take on. As always, should you be caught or killed, we will disavow any knowledge of your actions. [color=red][italic]This guidebook page will self destruct in 5 seconds[/italic][/color]. Good luck agent.
## Your Mission
As a Spy, you are tasked with any number of random mission suggestions. These may include anything from "Setting the Engineering department on fire" (something they usually accomplish on their own) to "Frame someone for a crime they didn't commit". These objectives are purely suggestions: Feel free to come up with your own mission to undergo. Or just steal things. Whichever's more fun to you!
## Your Equipment
As a Spy, you are equipped with a Spy Uplink. The Spy Uplink is similar to a Traitor's Syndicate Uplink, but with some key differences: - Only you and any other Spy can access your Spy uplink. - You don't need to concern yourself with remembering to lock it when you're done. - You cannot directly buy gear with telecrystals the way normal traitors can
By default, your uplink is implanted into your PDA. If you don't have a PDA, or you lost one, you can always [bold]Right Click[/bold] any PDA and make it into your new uplink.
To access your uplink, simply [bold]Right Click[/bold] your PDA and select "View Bounties"
## Your Bounties
Spy Bounties are your method of acquiring equipment to accomplish your mission.
Using your uplink in hand will open up the Spy Bounty list. These bounties and their corresponding rewards are shared between [bold]ALL SPIES[/bold] on board, and only one spy can claim a bounty, meaning it's in your best interest not to share your identity with other agents if you can help it! If you see that bounty is already [bold]Claimed[/bold] - it means you are too late and someone else already stole it.
Bounties consist of minor tasks to steal certain items, machines, or body parts from the crew. These can be anything from a basic pair of insulated gloves, to the AI upload, to the clown's pie-ing arm.
To claim a bounty, [bold]Click[/bold] on the bounty target with your uplink. It will take a moment, show a (pretty obvious) visual tell and a (less obvious) audible tell, so remember to be sneaky!
But what do you get for claiming bounties? Rewards! For stealing items, your employer will use their black market ties to acquire you one of many Illegal Syndicate Devices!
This includes most Traitor items, but also some items only available to Nuclear Operative and Spy agents!
The more difficult the bounty, the more valuable the reward. Start small and build up to the big guns! The general difficulty of a bounty is determined by the text it appears in, green meaning easy, yellow being medium, and red being hard.
After a set period of time, all bounties will refresh - claimed or not - giving all spies a new set of items to pursue.
## Why can't I claim the bounty?
Bounty could be claimed by someone else, check your uplink and see if it is marked as claimed.
Some bounties require target to be extracted in specific area which is mentioned in bounty description.
Some departments and jobs are blacklisted from certain bounties which should be mentioned in bounty description as well.
Most bounties require specific items that already existed on the station prior to bounty refresh. You cannot just construct a machine and steal it - you need the machine that already was present on the station.
